checkIn(bytes32,bytes32).details: The challenge must match the one derived from the CURRENT block. A code      read off the screen four blocks ago is already worthless.

currentChallenge(bytes32).details: Derived from the block number, so it rotates every CHALLENGE_BLOCKS blocks      with no transaction and no keeper. Nobody issues it; everybody can compute it.

finalize(bytes32,address[]).details: Trusted action, deliberately. Check-in itself is not trusted — that is the      point of the challenge. Addresses that already checked in are skipped rather      than reverting, so one bad entry cannot brick the whole batch.

payout(bytes32,address[],uint40).details: This contract never custodies USDC — x402 settles straight to the      organiser's address — so it cannot move the money itself. The transfer is      an EOA-side send; this function is the on-chain record of it, so /manage      and the receipt view have a source of truth that is not a server's memory.      Call it AFTER the transfer settles. Recording a payout that then fails to      send leaves a row claiming money that never arrived.      Addresses that did not check in, or that were already paid, are skipped      rather than reverting, so the batch is idempotent and one bad entry cannot      brick the call.

params.authRef: Reference to the off-chain x402 authorisation backing this hold.

admin().notice: The organiser. A single address is the correct amount of structure here.

checkIn(bytes32,bytes32).notice: Prove you are in the room.

currentChallenge(bytes32).notice: The code currently shown on the venue screen.

finalize(bytes32,address[]).notice: Charge the outstanding holds and close the event.

payout(bytes32,address[],uint40).notice: Record that attendees who showed up have been paid their share of the         charged no-show holds.

registeredCount(bytes32).notice: Per event, never global — a global counter would serialise otherwise         parallel registrations.

screen(bytes32,address).notice: Everything the attendee's screen needs, in one call.
